parameters.description: Only items from one institution, by Figshare's number for it. 'Get a collection' shows a collection's institution number; for example 2 is Loughborough University and 5 is PLOS.
parameters.name: institution

parameters.description: Only items from one group within an institution, such as a department or a journal, by its number. Every result shows the group number it came from.
parameters.name: group

parameters.description: What to sort by. Date published by default. Figshare has no relevance order, so sorting by views is the way to see the best-known items first.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Newest or highest first by default, so the most recent or most viewed come first.
parameters.name: order_direction

parameters.description: How many to return in one go, up to 1,000. 20 if left empty. Figshare reaches the first 10,000 results at most, so narrow a search rather than paging deep into it.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Which page of results, from 1. A result's next page field says which to ask for next.
parameters.name: page

count.description: How many came back on this page.

more_available.description: Whether the page came back full, so the next page may hold more. Figshare does not say how many match in all.

next_page.description: The page number to ask for next, or empty when this is the last page (or the 10,000th result has been reached).

page_size.description: How many were asked for per page.

projects.description: The projects found, in the order asked for.

created_date.description: When it was created, as an ISO 8601 UTC time.

id.description: The project's Figshare number. Every other project action takes it.

modified_date.description: When it last changed, as an ISO 8601 UTC time.

published_date.description: When it was published, as an ISO 8601 UTC time.

title.description: The title as plain text, on one line.

description: Find and read the research published on Figshare from a workflow: datasets, figures, papers, posters, code and theses from universities, publishers and researchers worldwide. Search by words, research category, kind of item, institution and publication date; read an item's title, authors, DOI, licence, categories, citation and description as plain text; list its versions and its files with direct download links; and browse collections and projects with the items in them. Every action reads public records: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
